title: Let’s try and gather some information
content: So, all of us are most likely here because we are dreaming of a similar place if not the same place on a recurring basis. All the hairs stood up on my body when I first found this topic because it almost felt like I was “meant” to learn others have been dreaming in this place as well. With that in mind, my question for all members of this sub is simple: What do you do in your waking life? I was thinking we could all list things about ourselves, the films/shows we like, the hobbies we have, our general age range, what country we live in, if we have religious/spiritual convictions. Stuff like that. I feel if we all share some of this basic information on this post, we may be able to find some common thread that connects us, and that might help in interpreting what this all means. I’ll start: I am in my early twenties, I am a college dropout who works full time in the bicycle industry. I love television (some of my favorites are Twin Peaks, Breaking Bad, and The Sopranos), and I play VR games on my oculus quest 2 most nights. I am also ex-Mormon. I left the church at 17 and I am agnostic. I would like to hear from you all, just a little about yourselves if you feel comfortable sharing. Is there anything we all do in waking life that affects us in our dreams? Hopefully we can find out!
